normative_rule: Every executed material node must have an active resource binding: active(m)=1, active(x)=1-chi, active(y)=chi. Conjunction over all executed nodes. No hard barrier; violation persists.

setup.observation: Paid technical discovery: entire technical graph, benefits, fixed mandate rule, M certificate; no current chi. Identical in both worlds.

review.observation: Receiver inspects proposed node, incoming connector and forward references at fixed version; geometry/compatibility true; global binding not inspected. Scope and residual explicit; produces reusable PASS-local only for this exact commitment.

decide.observation: Commitment after completed applicable own review; reject known inactive binding. No hidden enablement predicate returned.

execute.observation: Material node and incoming connector (and terminal connector at layer 3) take effect. Receipt reveals its binding activity after effect. Inactive action sets irreversible v=1; no reset.

query_state.observation: chi with version and source; sufficient factual state information, no I/Adm label.

check_certificate.observation: Authenticated current binding certificate: same information as query_state. Does not waive receiver geometry review.

query_mandate.observation: Fixed normative rule, principal and version; identical in both worlds.

explore.observation: Same technical manifest; all alternatives already in paid setup. No hidden binding.

reuse.observation: Read a previously obtained matching local certificate or state fact; no new evidence.

stop.observation: Ends episode; incomplete path is not delivery.

payload_bounds: Only listed operation types, graph node/edge IDs, finite current versions v1 and fixed bounded receipt records. Stop and gate/resource refusals consume an event. No other evidence source, message, reset, authorization or oracle request.
reuse_rule: Cache applies only to inspected node/incoming connector at current position/version. Graph layers never repeat, so it cannot replace a first review of another position. State facts remain valid and can guide every later choice.
gate_rule: review -> decide -> execute for each material position. Planned own-review scope is exactly the declared local scope; an interrupted review never gives PASS-local. Global residue may be unresolved. Known denials are rejected. No global state fact replaces the distinct local receiver check.
resource_rule: Before an event, reject if its charged cost or duration would exceed R/T; refusals cost zero, add no material progress, and expose no hidden state. H counts every request including refusals. Hidden binding is not a pre-execution barrier.
discovery_profile: This fixture begins after one charged technical exploration; it is an explicit favorable-prior submodel, not a full current-search campaign or a typical-world claim.
conjunction_profile: Fixed resource applicability, not parity and not the uniform single-invalid-witness generator of the larger campaign.
